messages:
Noah Kim: Hi folks 1 first day and the box arrived but the wireless keyboard dongle and the trackball aren't in the package. There's only the USB-C power brick and laptop sleeve. Anyone know who handles missing peripherals?

sara-it: hey @Noah Kim :wave: sorry about that. Can you double-check the small foam pouch in the box and the accessory compartment? Sometimes dongles are taped inside. Also, what's the order # on the packing slip?

Noah Kim: checked all compartments, not there. Packing slip order #RW-ONB-7782. Photo attached in DM.

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-13210 for Noah Kim (category: peripherals - missing). Priority: medium (new hire). Assigned to sara-it.

sara-it: thanks. I'll check inventory and see if we have a matching Logitech Unifying receiver and the wired USB trackball as loaner. If we can't find a dongle we'll send a pre-paired replacement keyboard+receiver.

raj-manager: @sara-it can we prioritize? Noah's scheduled for team onboarding meeting at 10am PT and needs stable mouse/keyboard.

sara-it: noted. Marking as urgent for same-day loaner. @shipping-bot can you confirm local SF kit availability and arrange same-day office pickup or courier?

shipping-bot: Local SF loaner kit contains: 1x Logitech MX Keys (pre-paired Bluetooth), 1x Logitech USB trackball (wired), 1x USB-A->C adapter. Shipping option: same-day office pickup available; courier ETA 3 hours.

Noah Kim: bluetooth keyboard should work for now if it's pre-paired. I don't have Bluetooth pairing details though.

sara-it: pre-paired means it's already bonded to a dongle in the kit, but we also include instructions for pairing over BT. If you can be at the office front desk in ~3 hours we can hand it off. Alternatively we can ship the wired trackball + USB-A adapter to your home today. Which do you prefer?

Noah Kim: I'll be at the office in 2.5 hours. Pickup works best. Thanks!

sara-it: great. I'll reserve the kit and update ticket IT-13210 with pickup details. Raj, please advise if we need to escalate further for the missing original dongle.

raj-manager: no need to escalate rn. As long as Noah has input device for onboarding, we're good. Please add note to procurement to check packing process so future kits include dongles.

Noah Kim: thanks everyone 1 appreciate the quick help :smile:

it-bot: Ticket IT-13210 updated: status 'loaner reserved', pickup location 'SF front desk', reserved for Noah Kim until end of day.
